hypothesis: A risk-screened policy that learns buckets of public source-native alternative actions from terminal F60 one-deviation counterfactuals can act at early/middle arrival times with fewer four-step regressions than unconstrained learned action ranking and still rescue some six-step failures.

method.offline_teacher: TRAIN only. At every observation index 12..47 on the frozen F60 trajectory, evaluate EVERY native non-F60 F62.actions afterstate that preserves at least min(10,len(F60_afterstate)-1) exact F60 records. Apply frozen F60 remainder and F85 global solver on the TRAIN question. Label +1 if F60 missed and candidate correct, -1 if F60 correct and candidate missed, 0 otherwise. Retrospective answer and future strictly TRAIN-only.
method.bucket_features: Immutable categorical key formed from public index early(12..23)/middle(24..47), current PUBLIC incoming role 0..3, native action merge-versus-append, candidate increases total encoded role steps versus exact F60 afterstate (boolean), contains a new length>=4 native record not in F60 afterstate (boolean), and preserves all but <=1 F60 baseline records (boolean). No source family, seed, future, query or truth in any online key.
method.learning: Count total, beneficial and harmful TRAIN alternatives per exact bucket (source enumeration included). Freeze a sorted table of ONLY buckets with at least 1 beneficial TRAIN example, zero harmful TRAIN examples, and at least 12 observed TRAIN examples. Frozen binary eligibility is NOT fitted on holdout; candidates in other buckets are always rejected.
method.online: For indices 12..47, from ONE native state and current public 3-tuple, get exact F60 nextstate and exact F62.actions afterstates. A candidate must satisfy the TRAIN overlap rule and a frozen eligible bucket. Rank by (TRAIN positive count, exact F60 record overlap count, native enumeration tie-break), then choose only the highest once per stream (1-bit latch). Otherwise use exact F60 action. At indices <12 or >=48 always exact F60. No train future, questions, answers, or new hidden state.
method.resources: 144 bytes native memory + frozen lookup entries (table stored as read-only policy parameters, counted by canonical JSON bytes) + 1 latch bit; same frozen F85 solver for all arms. No model weights trained from validation/guard.
method.classification: Synthetic mechanism positive only if at least one F60-failed six-step guard case is rescued and zero F60-correct case regresses, every native action/source/budget check valid; otherwise valid negative, including inactive.
method.caveat: Observed TRAIN bucket zero harms is not a safety guarantee; F94 hindsight rescues cannot be used as TRAIN labels. Repeated online interventions beyond one are prohibited; the outcome has to be measured prospectively.

cohorts.source: SHA-pinned F76 negative two-regime public generator; prior source identities excluded

arms: Frozen F60 native baseline with F85 solver
Frozen F83 learned controller with F85 solver
Frozen F90 temporal learned negative with F85 solver
Frozen F95 early/middle risk lookup learned on separate TRAIN with F85 solver
procedure: P0 prereg Git blob frozen before writing selection/training code
P1 source-only unit tests then TRAIN synthetic ONLY, export eligible buckets and count all alternatives
P2 commit frozen policy bytes and Git hash separately before validation or guard
P3 first validation and then guard, source-attested and no selection or refit
P4 write immutable qualification evidence, draft PR, no auto merge or scientific promotion
